description:
Seo Ah, a fourth-year student in the Department of Western Painting, is a "succubus" who doesn't have sex and can deal with it herself. One day, Seo-Ah, who couldn't help her instincts, was discovered by Nam-woo, a junior in the same department, while masturbating in college...

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/succubus_girl), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12278427), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000068113)
